sql.ahj.list: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, st.id as state_id, st.state, ahj.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area FROM brs.ahj ahj INNER JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = ahj.metro_area_id INNER JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON ma.sales_area_id = sa.id INNER JOIN flow.state st ON sa.state_id = st.id WHERE ahj.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY st.state, ma.metro_area, ahj.name
sql.ahj.findById: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, st.id as state_id, st.state, ahj.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area FROM brs.ahj ahj INNER JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = ahj.metro_area_id INNER JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON ma.sales_area_id = sa.id INNER JOIN flow.state st ON sa.state_id = st.id WHERE ahj.id = :id
sql.ahj.checkForDuplicate: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, st.id as state_id, st.state, ahj.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area FROM brs.ahj ahj INNER JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = ahj.metro_area_id INNER JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON ma.sales_area_id = sa.id INNER JOIN flow.state st ON sa.state_id = st.id WHERE ahj.name = :name AND ahj.metro_area_id = :metroAreaId AND ahj.archived is not true
sql.ahj.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj (name, metro_area_id, created, created_by_id, updated, updated_by_id) VALUES (:name, :metroAreaId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.update: UPDATE brs.ahj SET name = :name, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, updated = now(), updated_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.delete: update brs.ahj SET archived = true where id = :id
